formulaBlock.normalization: Aqua/Water/Eau and Parfum/Fragrance one entry each; normalized one-based positions.
formulaBlock.e3ProminenceCutoff: Parfum/Fragrance listed last (24) -> positions 1-23 mechanically prominent (atypical ordering; recorded)

cleansingStrength.rationale: C6: no strong anionic. Earliest cleansing surfactant Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate (2, mild anionic) with prominent Decyl Glucoside (3) and Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4) -> low.
cleansingStrength.counterSignals: Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate (14) minor anionic; not a strong route.

conditioningLevel.rationale: W-RICH: prominent payload lipids Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil (7) and Hydrogenated Castor Oil (12) converge with silicone Amodimethicone (10) and cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (11) - a rich architecture, which counts for conditioning (Section 6, W-RICH). Also Hydrolyzed Keratin (6), Glycol Distearate (15).
conditioningLevel.counterSignals: C2 humectant element missing: no Glycerin/Panthenol/Urea/other closed-list humectant (Hexylene Glycol does not count, R11). Oil sits after salt, so amounts may be small.

weightPotential.rationale: W-RICH (prominent argan oil and waxy hydrogenated castor oil converging with amodimethicone and guar) with limited reset (resetCapacity weak, mild sulfate-free C6 chassis) reaches the high anchor's rich route.

depositionLoad.rationale: Silicone (10) + cationic guar (11) + two payload lipids (7, 12) + keratin (6) + fatty acid (13).

persistence.rationale: Amodimethicone and waxy hydrogenated castor oil are substantive; argan oil and protein moderate.

unresolved: Sodium Hydrolyzed Potato Starch Dodecenylsuccinate (8): amphiphilic anionic modified starch; not band-moving (band already high on other evidence)
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Multiple converging, plausibly persistent depositing systems (silicone, cationic, two lipids) with weak reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: W-RICH plus limited reset (weak) satisfies the high anchor's rich route, and four deposition families converge; there is no strong surfactant system to offset them.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Lipids and silicone sit after salt in a sulfate-free base; actual levels may be low, so moderate is a realistic neighbor.

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula-only candidate: repair (keratin + argan oil + amodimethicone + guar substantive cluster); no closed-list humectant, so moisture is less supported.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Positioning unknown. CSA formula half met via E4 humectant/refatting route: nonvolatile plant oil Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil (7) and hydrogenated lipid Hydrogenated Castor Oil (12), prominent. No comfort route.
